1_database_information.note: OpenAlex polite pool + Semantic Scholar (supplement). Audit may add PubMed/arXiv.

2_multi_database_searching.rationale: Multi-database search reduces single-source bias (Bramer 2018: 98.3% recall achievable with >=2 databases).

3_study_registries.note: Not queried by default. Available via audit tier add-ons if user enables Cochrane/ClinicalTrials.

4_online_resources_browsing.note: Out of scope for this skill; pre-supplied via user citation seeds when relevant.

5_citation_searching.method: OpenAlex forward+backward citation chase up to configured max_hops.

6_contacts.note: Skill does not contact authors; relies on published records only.

8_full_search_strategies.note: Strategy reproducible; same boolean expressions executed against each database.

9_limits_and_restrictions.note: No restrictive filters by default; tier budget bounds the number of records returned.

10_search_filters.note: No pre-validated hedges used; query plan uses LLM-decomposed terms.

11_prior_work.note: User-supplied force_include DOIs (config force_include) are merged into the result set.

12_updates.note: Not incremental within a single run; checkpoint enables manual re-run on demand.

15_deduplication.method: FederatedKG dedup: DOI (Level 1) -> arXiv ID (Level 2) -> PMID/OpenAlex/SS fallback -> (normalized_title, year) (last resort). E5b guard prevents same-title-different-DOI collapse.
15_deduplication.note: Provenance preserved per paper in sources[].

16_record_management.format: JSONL append-only checkpoint + materialized JSON outputs
